newsitem.title: USA: Official urges Atlantic City build light rail.
newsitem.headline: Official urges Atlantic City build light rail.

text.p: Sen. Robert Torricelli, D-N.J., has proposed a light rail line for Atlantic City.

Speaking at a gaming symposium as the city opened its new convention center, Torricelli said the island city needs an elevated light rail system to end congestion and connect the convention center to casinos.
The rail could be funded by casino revenue with help from the federal and state governments, Torricelli said.
Local officials, however, gave the proposal little chance of becoming reality, given the high cost and intense local opposition.

Persian Gulf War commander General Norman Schwarzkopf and New Jersey Gov. Christine Whitman spoke at opening ceremonies for the $268 million convention center, which is desinged as the centerpiece of the city's non-gambling tourism strategy.
